Trickle pricing plans | Simple plans for building dreams

name: Trickle
summary: AI app builder that turns natural-language prompts into live websites and apps, with built-in image and video generation and hosting.
description: An agentic canvas for vibe coding: describe an app or site and Trickle builds it with built-in image and video generation, AI models, database and design, then hosts it on a trickle.host subdomain or a custom domain. A template gallery offers reusable apps, sites and components (Profile Card, Flip Card, Lamp Container, Laser Flow and more), alongside free tools, a blog and a changelog.
contains: builds websites and apps from natural-language prompts
template and component gallery (apps, sites, UI components)
built-in image and video generation, AI models, database
hosting on trickle.host subdomains or custom domains
free plan with 70 daily credits (up to 350/month), Pro $17/month, Premium $42/month
